name: A1_physionet_paper
status: READY_AFTER_CACHE (run once per inner fold 0,1,2 = the paper's three validation folds)
protocol: PROTOCOL_PHASE1.md section 3 (A1): fresh weights, paper folds (original folds 0-8, model k validates on fold k), evaluation on the historically exposed fold 9 only after the recipe is frozen; paper-stated selection (macro-AUROC, patience 15, evaluation every 5 epochs)
deviations_from_paper: batch 256 realised as 64x4 gradient accumulation (BatchNorm statistics differ from true batch 256; measured logit effect in results/phase1_infrastructure/hw_benchmark.json)
FP32 instead of the paper's BFloat16 (bf16 is emulated on the GTX 1650)
augmentation details not given by the paper are fixed in data_v3.py (circular roll, 1-3 leads dropped)
TCN kernel sizes / block dropouts are the recovered V2 values, not paper-confirmed
rare-class fine-tuning, 3-fold ensemble, validation-calibrated thresholds and 5-pass TTA are separate stages (not in train_v3.py yet)
